messages.author: 994731d36eeef20c
messages.subject: MSstat's DF
parts:
Hi all,
Comparing the DF column on my old msstats runs (prior to version 3), I noticed that the way DF is being calculated now is quite different. In previous versions, if I'm not wrong, DF was feature-based and now it seems to be based on number of sample replicates. I just want to confirm this intentional change and make sure that there isn't anything wrong with MSstats since I could not find anything in the change log anyway. 
Thanks, 
Alex

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstat's DF
parts:
Dear Alex,

Correct. In current version of MSstats, degree of freedom is based on the number of MS runs. Inference is performed with run-level summarized values. (features are summarized before inference step.) We are wrapping up the manuscript about new approach. I hope that user manual (workflows > user manual in msstats.org) will help. 

- Meena
